verses.1: Jehovah, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty; Neither do I exercise myself in great matters, Or in things too wonderful for me.
verses.2: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; Like a weaned child with his mother, Like a weaned child is my soul within me.
verses.3: O Israel, hope in Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore.

metadata.source: Derived from the American Standard Version (1901), revised for the ABIDE Bible App.
